The samples were formed on a RENISHAW AM-400 LPBF platform (Fig. 1(c)) using the following process parameters: substrate preheating temperature = 120 °C, laser power = 200 W, line spacing = 80 μm, point spacing = 60 μm, exposure time = 80 μs, wavelength = 1070 nm, layer thickness = 40 μm, and interlayer rotation angle = 67° (Fig. 1(d)).
